keywords: EIP-8288 改名“内存池内签名与证明聚合”
SizzLean 形式化验证 SSZ 库
summary: 周日 EIP-8288 密集修订：Vitalik 把标题改为“内存池内签名与证明聚合”，ilitteri 连续提交 PR 明确聚合电路要求、依赖验证帧的位置、收据和不得放入原子批量。EIP-8141 有 PR 提议按节点可判定的资金流出属性而非精确代码匹配来接纳付款方。SizzLean 发布形式化验证的 Lean 4 SSZ 库。

items.note: （AnkushinDaniil，后关闭）。目前付款方要么代码与标准实现完全一致，要么被视为非标准并限制为一笔待处理交易，而该限制只因非标准付款方的 ETH 流出不受控。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: admit paymasters by a node-decidable egress property
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil, later closed). Today a paymaster either exactly matches the canonical code or is treated as non-canonical and capped at one pending transaction, a cap that exists only because a non-canonical paymaster's ETH egress is uncontrolled.

keywords_en: EIP-8288 renamed "In-mempool signature and proof aggregation"
summary_en: A burst of EIP-8288 revisions on Sunday: Vitalik retitled it "In-mempool signature and proof aggregation", and ilitteri submitted a series of PRs specifying the aggregation circuit's properties, where a dependency verification frame may sit, its receipt, and its exclusion from atomic batches. An EIP-8141 PR proposed admitting paymasters by a node-decidable egress property rather than an exact code match. SizzLean released a formally verified Lean 4 SSZ library.
